text: They've also been able to use drones and ballistic missiles, weapons they didn't have before, that are actually therefore able to kill a lot of people tragically in Saudi Arabia. Why have they targeted Saudi Arabia in particular? Because Saudi had spent a lot of its oil revenue trying to wean itself off dependence on the Strait of Hormuz by building a massive pipeline from the east side of the country to the west, so they could offload oil into the Red Sea and therefore use the Baba Mandab Straits. Now the Houthis are targeting that, all of which designed to make life uncomfortable, push energy prices high, and put more pressure onto Donald Trump.
